summary: As your business grows to store millions to billions of objects and terabytes to petabytes of data on Amazon S3, it becomes increasingly valuable to use tools and automation to handle that scale. Effective storage cost optimization can require different approaches depending on application latency and access patterns. In this episode, Simon is joined by Andrew Kutsy and Jessie Felix, Amazon S3 product managers, to discuss key considerations for optimizing your storage. Learn how Amazon S3 enables business transformation and helps you innovate faster with a range of storage classes, and tools such as S3 Storage Lens to identify cost savings opportunities. Learn about Amazon S3 - https://aws.amazon.com/s3/ Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering - https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/intelligent-tiering Amazon S3 Glacier storage classes - https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/glacier/ Amazon S3 Storage Lens - https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-analytics-insights/
title: #545: Transform Your Business Faster by Optimizing Storage Costs Automatically with Amazon S3

summary: In this episode, Hawn is joined by Shridhar Kulkarni (Product Manager, AWS) to discuss the newly launched AWS Cloud WAN. They dive into how AWS Cloud WAN makes it easy to bring your network to the cloud, as well as it's efficiency, management, and security benefits. Listen to learn more about AWS Cloud WAN and how to unify your on-premises and cloud networks, and simplify how you build, manage, and monitor your wide area network.
